content: Ayt n Rikab
Awař n SIDI i dd-yusin ɣar Irmiya deg wussan n Yahuyaqim, mmis n Yuciya, ajeǧid n Yahuda, inna:
“Uyur ɣar taddart n ayt n Rikab uca siweř akidsen u awyi ten ɣar Taddart n SIDI, deg ijj zeg ixxamen nnes, u ewc asen binu ḥima ad swen.”
Xenni iwyeɣ-dd Yazanyahu, mmis n Irmiya, mmis n Ḥabṣiniya, jmiɛ ak-d marra aytmas d marra iḥenjiren nnes d marra taddart n ayt n Rikab.
Iwyeɣ ten ɣar Taddart n SIDI, deg wexxam n ayt n Ḥanan, mmis n Yajdalya, aryaz n AREBBI, axxam nni iǧan zzat i wexxam n řḥukkam, tiwa i wexxam n Maɛasiya, mmis n Callum, aɛessas n tewwart.
Necc ssarseɣ iɣarrafen ccuren s binu d řkisan zzat i wudem n ayt n Rikab uca nniɣ asen: ‘Swem binu!’
Maca nitni nnan: ‘Neccin war nsess ca binu, maɣar babatneɣ Yunadab, mmis n Rikab, iweṣṣa aneɣ, inna: Kenniw ɛemmarṣ war ttsessem binu, kenniw d iḥenjiren nwem, ař i řebda.

War iɛeddeř ad tebnam taddart niɣ ad tzarɛem zzariɛet niɣ ad teẓẓum tazayart deg umarjeɛ niɣ ad ɣarwem yiři umarjeɛ n uḍiř, maca min ɣa tekkem teddarem ad tzedɣem deg iqiḍan, maḥend ad teddarem ussan aṭṭas di temmurt mani i ɣa tzedɣem am yibarraniyyen.
Neccin nesřa ɣar babatneɣ Yunadab, mmis n Rikab, di marra min zi i d aneɣ iweṣṣa, maḥend war nsess binu marra tudart nneɣ, neccin d temɣarin nneɣ d iḥenjiren nneɣ d yessitneɣ,
u maḥend war nbenni tudrin d tazeddiɣt i yixef nneɣ. War ɣarneɣ bu umarjeɛ n uḍiř niɣ iyyar niɣ zzariɛet,
uca neccin tuɣa nzeddeɣ deg iqiḍan. Ammu i nesřa u negga ɛlaḥṣab marra min zi i d aneɣ iweṣṣa babatneɣ Yunadab.

Umi maca Nabuxadnaṣṣar, ajeǧid n Babil, igeɛɛed x temmurt-a, imsar, aqa nenna: Asem-dd, ad nraḥ ɣar Urcalim zi ssibbet n řɛeskar n Ikaldaniyyen u zi ssibbet n řɛeskar n Aram! S uyenni i nzeddeɣ di Urcalim.’”
Xenni yusa-dd wawař n SIDI ɣar Irmiya, inna:
“Ammu i iqqar SIDI n řɛeskarat, AREBBI n Israil: Uyur, ini i yeryazen n Yahuda u i imezdaɣ n Urcalim: ‘Ma war tᵉttexsem ad teksim ttarbiyyet s utesři i wawařen inu?’, iqqar SIDI.

Awařen n Yunadab, mmis n Rikab, inni yumur i iḥenjiren nsen ḥima war sessen binu, aqa ḍfaren ten-dd, maɣar ař ass-a war swin ca, minzi nitni sřin ɣar tewṣeyyet n babatsen, maca Necc ssiwřeɣ akidwem, wah ɛad zeg umezwaru ssiwřeɣ akidwem, maca kenniw war ɣari dd-tesřim ca.

Necc ssekkeɣ-dd ɣarwem marra imsexxaren inu, inabiyyen. Ɛad zic sekkeɣ ten ḥima ad inin: Dewřem-dd xenni, kuř ijj zeg webrid nnes aɛeffan u ggem řexdayem tiṣebḥanin u war traddafem irebbiten nneɣni maḥend ad asen tsexxarem, xenni tzemmarem ad teqqimem tzedɣem di temmurt i d awem wciɣ u i řejdud nwem. Kenniw maca war tewcim amezzuɣ u war ɣari tesřim.
Iḥenjiren n Yunadab, mmis n Rikab, ssqefřen tawṣeyyet n babatsen nni ten yumur, maca řgens-a war ɣari isři ca.”

“S uya, ammu i iqqar SIDI, AREBBI n řɛeskarat, AREBBI n Israil: Xzar, Necc ad awyeɣ x Yahuda u x marra imezdaɣ n Urcalim marra řɣar nni d asen nniɣ, minzi ssiwřeɣ akidsen maca nitni war sřin ca, uca řaɣiɣ asen maca nitni war dd-arrin ca.”

Inna Irmiya i taddart n ayt n Rikab: “Ammu i iqqar SIDI n řɛeskarat, AREBBI n Israil: ‘Umi tesřim ɣar tewṣeyyet n babatwem Yunadab uca teḥḍam marra tiweṣṣa nnes u teggim ɛlaḥsab marra min d awem yumur,
x uya, ammu i iqqar SIDI n řɛeskarat, AREBBI n Israil: Marra ussan war ittxeṣṣi ɛemmarṣ i Yunadab, mmis n Rikab, ijj n weryaz nni ittbeddan zzat i wudem inu!’”

footnotes.text: marra tudart nneɣ- s Tɛibranit ‘marra ussan nneɣ’.
